user.title: Site location
user.description: Where your panels are. Arrays are added afterwards, one per roof plane.

data_description.elevation: Metres above sea level. Only weakly affects the clear-sky model.
data_description.ground_type: What surrounds the array. Sets the ground reflectance used for the reflected component of plane-of-array irradiance.
data_description.inverter_ac_limit: Leave empty unless your inverter actually clips. A limit set too low truncates the forecast at the sunniest part of the day.
data_description.name: Shown on the site device and used to name its entities.

abort.already_configured: A site is already configured at this location.

user.title: Add a solar array
user.description: One array per roof plane. Panels facing different directions, or at different tilts, need separate arrays.

data_description.azimuth: Compass degrees the panels face: 0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west.
data_description.dc_capacity: Total nameplate rating of the panels on this plane.
data_description.dc_loss: Soiling, wiring, mismatch and connections combined. The default suits most systems.
data_description.name: Used for this array's device and entity names.
data_description.shading_file: Optional. Filename inside your Home Assistant config/soular directory. Accepts a graded transmittance grid (.npz or .csv) or a two-column horizon file (.txt).
data_description.temperature_coefficient: From the module datasheet, typically around -0.35 %/°C.
data_description.tilt: Degrees from horizontal. 0 is flat, 90 is vertical.
